title: Scheduling Periodic Software Updates in Private Access

blocks.text: You can schedule the date and time when a software component automatically updates to ensure that it doesn't interfere with operations. Software components refer to App Connectors, Private Service Edges for Private Access (ZPA), Private Cloud Controllers, and Network Connectors. Review the following sections to schedule a periodic software update:

blocks.item: For an App Connector group
From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Private Infrastructure > App Connector Groups.
In the table, locate the App Connector group and click the Edit icon.
On the Edit App Connector Group page, click the Update Settings tab.
On the Update Settings tab, under App Connector Software Update Schedule, choose the day of the week and start time for the periodic update.
See image.
Click Save.
To confirm that the update was scheduled, go to the App Connector Groups page and verify that the proper day and time is displayed in the Next Periodic Software Update column.
For a Private Service Edge group
From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Private Infrastructure > Private Service Edge Groups.
In the table, locate the Private Service Edge group and click the Edit icon.
In the Edit Private Service Edge Group window, under Private Service Edge Software Update Schedule, choose the day of the week and start time for the periodic update.
See image.
Click Save.
To confirm that the update was scheduled, go to the Service Edge Groups page and verify that the proper day and time is displayed in the Next Periodic Software Update column.
For a Private Cloud Controller group
To ensure that Business Continuity functions properly, Private Cloud Controllers must run on the same or a later software version as the App Connectors and Private Service Edges.
From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Business Continuity > Private Cloud Controller Groups.
In the table, locate the Private Cloud Controller group and click the Edit icon.
On the Edit Private Cloud Controller Group page, under Private Cloud Controller Software Update Schedule, choose the day of the week and start time for the periodic update.
See image.
Click Save.
To confirm that the update was scheduled, go to the Private Cloud Controller Groups page and verify that the proper day and time is displayed in the Next Periodic Software Update column.
For a Network Connector group
From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > VPN (for Legacy Apps) > Network Connector Groups.
In the table, locate the Network Connector group and click the Edit icon.
On the Edit Network Connector Group page, under Network Connector Software Update Schedule, choose the day of the week and start time for the periodic update.
See image.
Click Save.
To confirm that the update was scheduled, go to the Network Connector Groups page and verify that the proper day and time is displayed in the Next Periodic Software Update column.
